excerpt: Canonical definition A Blood Ring is a Drakken-made vitrified biospheric atrocity-structure from the Blood Eclipse War. Conquered populations, blood matter, bone ash, ocean fats, biosphere oils, mineral residue and terraforming compounds are rendered into a crimson glass-state composite, extruded into orbit…

source_claims.label: The first ring uses whole-world biological fractions
source_claims.statement: The Fallenstar process combines rendered flesh, bone, breath, ocean fats, biosphere oils, and other world matter into the feedstock later vitrified in orbit.

source_claims.label: Blood Ring maps are operational instruments
source_claims.statement: Codec maps approach vectors, blind corridors, and the distance at which orbital slurry makes instruments unreliable. The rings are treated as navigation hazards before they can be treated as symbols.

source_claims.label: He names the psychological hazard clinically
source_claims.statement: Field warnings use terms such as cognitive hazard, recursive despair, and spatial-moral disorientation to describe what unfiltered visualization of a world-made-ring can do to observers.
